title: Finially made a Godot game: Small Following
author: Kalaith
selftext:
I dont know why but I've never really liked the godot UI, it feels like it belongs in Windows 3.1

  
So AI has made this alot easier in that I havn't touched godot beyond checking its installed and running, I was actually surprised how painless the process was

  
But onto the game! Small Following

Start with a robe and a few convincing words. Build a small following.  
  
Explore a village, gather donations and recruit followers before each round ends. Spend your earnings in a sprawling ritual circle to sharpen your public speaking, move faster and unlock magical help. Every upgrade brings larger crowds and bigger towns within reach.  
  
Small Following is an incremental game about growing a cult, one conversation at a time.  
  
Demo available on WebHatchery https://webhatchery.au/games/small\_following/ and itch.io https://kalaith.itch.io/small-following

promo video on youtube [https://youtu.be/MlTFC6t5LE4](https://youtu.be/MlTFC6t5LE4)

I asked the AI to make a 1 minute clip using images and ingame recordings and it did a pretty nice job I think

For a demo its good, ive played and watched alot of idle games and I think this short demo works pretty well, do a map, get money, buy upgrades, do the map again but better, repeat. 

I have plenty of ideas for improving the first map and what future maps could look like and mechanics

This was built with Astra + Ultra + using Luna Extra High sub agents

The script also handled the publishing, but that was previously done in my rust projects, so this was mostly just a conversion.

tl;dr built a game using astra in godot and its a fun game. Ai made the game, the video and published it.
